rules: Complete registration before the event day (Deadline: 10 August 2026).
Carry your valid college ID card at all times.
Report to the venue at least 15 minutes before your session.
Follow all instructions given by AIDS Department coordinators.
Maintain discipline and respect fellow participants.
Mobile phones must be on silent during sessions.
Certificates will be given only to participants who attend the full session.

faqs.question: Where is the event?
faqs.answer: The event is held at SNJB KBJ College of Engineering, Chandwad — Lab No. 235, 2nd Floor, Left Side (AIDS Dept.), Nashik District, Maharashtra – 423101.

faqs.question: When is the AI Workshop?
faqs.answer: The AI & Technology Workshop is on 14 August 2026 from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Please report by 9:45 AM.

faqs.question: What are the rules?
faqs.answer: Key rules: (1) Carry your college ID. (2) Report 15 minutes early. (3) Follow AIDS Department coordinator instructions. (4) Phones on silent. (5) Attend full session for certificate.

faqs.question: What are the prizes?
faqs.answer: Amazing prizes await! 🥇 1st Prize — ₹2,000 Cash + Certificate | 🥈 2nd Prize — ₹1,500 Cash + Certificate | 🥉 3rd Prize — ₹1,000 Cash + Certificate. All participants get a participation certificate by AIDS Department!

faqs.question: When should I report?
faqs.answer: Please arrive at least 15 minutes before your session. Registration check-in opens at 09:00 AM on 15 August 2026.

faqs.question: Who can participate?
faqs.answer: All students of SNJB College of Engineering, Chandwad can participate. Registration is completely FREE!

faqs.question: How do I register? Is it free?
faqs.answer: Registration is 100% FREE! Click the Registration button in the menu, fill your Name, Email, Phone and College, then submit. Deadline: 10 August 2026.

faqs.question: What is the event schedule?
faqs.answer: 09:00 AM – Check-in | 10:00 AM – Opening Ceremony | 11:00 AM – AI Session | 01:00 PM – Lunch | 02:00 PM – Tech Presentation | 04:00 PM – Certificate Distribution.

faqs.question: When is the event?
faqs.answer: The AI & Technology Workshop is on 14 August 2026 (Friday). Registration deadline is 10 August 2026. Entry is FREE!

faqs.question: Who do I contact for help?
faqs.answer: The event coordinator is Miss. Sandhya Aghav Mam from the AIDS Department, SNJB College of Engineering, Chandwad. Contact: 9579001895. Feel free to call her for any queries!

faqs.question: What topics will be covered?
faqs.answer: The workshop covers: Artificial Intelligence basics, Machine Learning, Data Science, Real-world AI applications, and live Technology demonstrations by experts.

faqs.question: Is the workshop online or offline?
faqs.answer: The AI & Technology Workshop is an OFFLINE event at SNJB KBJ College of Engineering, Chandwad — Lab No. 235, 2nd Floor Left Side, AIDS Department. Physical attendance required for certificate.

faqs.question: Is food provided?
faqs.answer: Yes! Lunch and refreshments are provided to all registered participants during the lunch break (1:00 PM) by the AIDS Department.

faqs.question: What is the registration deadline?
faqs.answer: The last date for registration is 10 August 2026. Register early to confirm your seat. Registration is FREE!

faqs.question: Can I set a reminder?
faqs.answer: Yes! Click the Reminders button in the menu to see a live countdown timer to the AI & Technology Workshop on 14 August 2026.

faqs.question: Who is the coordinator of this event?
faqs.answer: The coordinator of this event is Miss. Sandhya Aghav Mam from the AIDS Department, SNJB College of Engineering, Chandwad. Contact Number: 9579001895.
